assumptions: Human-approved (#1170): one helper level credited; deeper indirection or an unresolvable helper body ABSTAINS for VAC-002, counted (helperAbstained / vac002_abstained) and listed in skipped, never reported and never silently passed.
Human-approved (#1171): compare the full call expression (callee + normalised arguments); identical calls including no-argument f() vs f() stay VAC-001 with no new code.

Root cause #1171: VAC-001 compared both sides on the string-blanked line, so string arguments collapsed to the same text. Fix compares the same offsets in the raw source, with whitespace stripped only outside string literals.

Root cause #1170: the issue's literal one-line snippet already passed at origin/main ffe44039; the failing shape is a prettier-wrapped helper, because declEnd (#871) ended a const initializer at the first newline. Fix continues past a line break when parens/brackets are open, the line ends in =>/an operator, or the next line starts with . ? : ) ] | &.

A function declaration's body now ends at its own closing brace (skipping an object return type), not at the next sibling declaration. Measured on canary's own ts/test this unmasked 16 findings that had been hidden by over-attribution; they are true positives under the rule's definition (the tests do not reference any first-party import).
An 'unresolvable helper' is a module-scope let/var declared without an initializer (e.g. assigned inside a hook) that the test calls; that is the only unresolvable shape implemented.
Typed const declarations (const x: T = ...) are still not recognised as local declarations; pre-existing gap, out of scope.
VAC-003/VAC-005 keep the full fixpoint closure; only VAC-002 moved to the one-level contract.

canary vacuity-check (ts CLI) discloses the abstentions through its existing skipped rendering; the dedicated count is added to the cassandra skill CLI only, which is what the approved decision named.
Measured impact numbers in the PR body come from the issues (an external repo) and are not re-measured; canary's own before/after numbers were measured locally on this branch.
